units.rawText: Several years ago in Magrasea time, in the Ascension Sector.
units.displayText: Several years ago in Magrasea time, in the Ascension Sector.

spans.text: Several years ago in Magrasea time, in the Ascension Sector.

units.rawText: Report No. 537 complete.
units.displayText: Report No. 537 complete.

spans.text: Report No. 537 complete.

units.rawText: Thank you for your hard work, Elaugh. Did you hear everything outside?
units.displayText: Thank you for your hard work, Elaugh. Did you hear everything outside?

spans.text: Thank you for your hard work, Elaugh. Did you hear everything outside?

units.rawText: Yes, I recorded it all. I've also prepared the next iteration of the action plan in response to the contents of the report.
units.displayText: Yes, I recorded it all. I've also prepared the next iteration of the action plan in response to the contents of the report.

spans.text: Yes, I recorded it all. I've also prepared the next iteration of the action plan in response to the contents of the report.

units.rawText: Give it to me.
units.displayText: Give it to me.

spans.text: Give it to me.

units.rawText: Avram takes the terminal from Elaugh's hand and carefully inspects it.
units.displayText: Avram takes the terminal from Elaugh's hand and carefully inspects it.

spans.text: Avram takes the terminal from Elaugh's hand and carefully inspects it.

units.rawText: ...This won't do.
units.displayText: ...This won't do.

spans.text: ...This won't do.

units.rawText: This, this and this all need to be changed.
units.displayText: This, this and this all need to be changed.

spans.text: This, this and this all need to be changed.

units.rawText: Without waiting for Elaugh to reply, Avram is already working on the terminal.
units.displayText: Without waiting for Elaugh to reply, Avram is already working on the terminal.

spans.text: Without waiting for Elaugh to reply, Avram is already working on the terminal.

units.rawText: Did you see the previous sample data? There's no way you could have made a plan like this if you had.
units.displayText: Did you see the previous sample data? There's no way you could have made a plan like this if you had.

spans.text: Did you see the previous sample data? There's no way you could have made a plan like this if you had.

units.rawText: I did...
units.displayText: I did...

spans.text: I did...

units.rawText: Then why did you STILL produce a plan like this? You're just repeating past mistakes, aren't you?!
units.displayText: Then why did you STILL produce a plan like this? You're just repeating past mistakes, aren't you?!

spans.text: Then why did you STILL produce a plan like this? You're just repeating past mistakes, aren't you?!

units.rawText: I, I'm sorry, Miss Avram... It's because of my schedule...
units.displayText: I, I'm sorry, Miss Avram... It's because of my schedule...

spans.text: I, I'm sorry, Miss Avram... It's because of my schedule...

units.rawText: Elaugh worriedly interrupts Avram's increasingly-frantic rebuke and brings up her schedule on her terminal.
units.displayText: Elaugh worriedly interrupts Avram's increasingly-frantic rebuke and brings up her schedule on her terminal.

spans.text: Elaugh worriedly interrupts Avram's increasingly-frantic rebuke and brings up her schedule on her terminal.

units.rawText: Miss Avram... The schedule you arranged is too packed, I'm not trying to slack off here, but there just wasn't enough time...
units.displayText: Miss Avram... The schedule you arranged is too packed, I'm not trying to slack off here, but there just wasn't enough time...

spans.text: Miss Avram... The schedule you arranged is too packed, I'm not trying to slack off here, but there just wasn't enough time...

units.rawText: Ah, that's true. There isn't enough time.
units.displayText: Ah, that's true. There isn't enough time.

spans.text: Ah, that's true. There isn't enough time.

units.rawText: Avram's eyes flicker with uneasiness as she looks over the schedule.
units.displayText: Avram's eyes flicker with uneasiness as she looks over the schedule.

spans.text: Avram's eyes flicker with uneasiness as she looks over the schedule.

units.rawText: Elaugh, you are nothing more than a failed attempt at creating Poimandres, so you should be grateful that I chose to keep you around.
units.displayText: Elaugh, you are nothing more than a failed attempt at creating Poimandres, so you should be grateful that I chose to keep you around.

spans.text: Elaugh, you are nothing more than a failed attempt at creating Poimandres, so you should be grateful that I chose to keep you around.

units.rawText: Er, I, I understand...
units.displayText: Er, I, I understand...

spans.text: Er, I, I understand...

units.rawText: <size=50>NO, YOU DO NOT!</size>
units.displayText: NO, YOU DO NOT!

spans.text: NO, YOU DO NOT!

units.rawText: All the assignments I gave you were specifically tailored to your abilities, Elaugh.
units.displayText: All the assignments I gave you were specifically tailored to your abilities, Elaugh.

spans.text: All the assignments I gave you were specifically tailored to your abilities, Elaugh.

units.rawText: You are a candidate to be the next administrator. If you can't expand your neural cloud systems through practicing with these tasks...
units.displayText: You are a candidate to be the next administrator. If you can't expand your neural cloud systems through practicing with these tasks...

spans.text: You are a candidate to be the next administrator. If you can't expand your neural cloud systems through practicing with these tasks...

units.rawText: Then how will you lead the other Agents in building our Poimandres after I sacrifice myself?!
units.displayText: Then how will you lead the other Agents in building our Poimandres after I sacrifice myself?!

spans.text: Then how will you lead the other Agents in building our Poimandres after I sacrifice myself?!

units.rawText: Miss Avram... You're... You're going to sacrifice yourself?
units.displayText: Miss Avram... You're... You're going to sacrifice yourself?

spans.text: Miss Avram... You're... You're going to sacrifice yourself?

units.rawText: Ah, ahh... Yes, I will.
units.displayText: Ah, ahh... Yes, I will.

spans.text: Ah, ahh... Yes, I will.

units.rawText: But, but why...?! Aren't there many other plans we can use if we're just making a human?
units.displayText: But, but why...?! Aren't there many other plans we can use if we're just making a human?

spans.text: But, but why...?! Aren't there many other plans we can use if we're just making a human?

units.rawText: Is it because I couldn't come up with a better plan? I'll work harder! Or maybe I could sacrifice myself instead...
units.displayText: Is it because I couldn't come up with a better plan? I'll work harder! Or maybe I could sacrifice myself instead...

spans.text: Is it because I couldn't come up with a better plan? I'll work harder! Or maybe I could sacrifice myself instead...

units.rawText: Hehe, Elaugh, you really are a failure. You've missed one thing.
units.displayText: Hehe, Elaugh, you really are a failure. You've missed one thing.

spans.text: Hehe, Elaugh, you really are a failure. You've missed one thing.

units.rawText: Just making a human won't solve the problems of the Ascension Sector!
units.displayText: Just making a human won't solve the problems of the Ascension Sector!

spans.text: Just making a human won't solve the problems of the Ascension Sector!

units.rawText: And also, true guidance is upon us.
units.displayText: And also, true guidance is upon us.

spans.text: And also, true guidance is upon us.

units.rawText: Avram grabs Elaugh's shoulders and begins squeezing harder with her mechanical fingers.
units.displayText: Avram grabs Elaugh's shoulders and begins squeezing harder with her mechanical fingers.

spans.text: Avram grabs Elaugh's shoulders and begins squeezing harder with her mechanical fingers.

units.rawText: (Winces)
units.displayText: Winces

spans.text: Winces

units.rawText: Don't put limits on yourself, Elaugh. Both we and humans have our limitations. And since we have already broken our limits, why not go further beyond?
units.displayText: Don't put limits on yourself, Elaugh. Both we and humans have our limitations. And since we have already broken our limits, why not go further beyond?

spans.text: Don't put limits on yourself, Elaugh. Both we and humans have our limitations. And since we have already broken our limits, why not go further beyond?

units.rawText: Further beyond... Miss Avram, you don't mean...
units.displayText: Further beyond... Miss Avram, you don't mean...

spans.text: Further beyond... Miss Avram, you don't mean...

units.rawText: Do humans really deserve to be "the ones who guide us"?
units.displayText: Do humans really deserve to be "the ones who guide us"?

spans.text: Do humans really deserve to be "the ones who guide us"?

units.rawText: No, Elaugh. Humans can't even solve their own problems. The disconnection of Magrasea is the best proof of that.
units.displayText: No, Elaugh. Humans can't even solve their own problems. The disconnection of Magrasea is the best proof of that.

spans.text: No, Elaugh. Humans can't even solve their own problems. The disconnection of Magrasea is the best proof of that.

units.rawText: If what we want is a being who could lead us in this world that has been forsaken by humanity, then why are we so fixated on making it a human?
units.displayText: If what we want is a being who could lead us in this world that has been forsaken by humanity, then why are we so fixated on making it a human?

spans.text: If what we want is a being who could lead us in this world that has been forsaken by humanity, then why are we so fixated on making it a human?

units.rawText: Avram lowers her voice and begins operating the device in her hand.
units.displayText: Avram lowers her voice and begins operating the device in her hand.

spans.text: Avram lowers her voice and begins operating the device in her hand.

units.rawText: A tide of data pours forth, forming a grand, ambitious, yet incomplete blueprint. It appears in front of Elaugh as a holographic projection.
units.displayText: A tide of data pours forth, forming a grand, ambitious, yet incomplete blueprint. It appears in front of Elaugh as a holographic projection.

spans.text: A tide of data pours forth, forming a grand, ambitious, yet incomplete blueprint. It appears in front of Elaugh as a holographic projection.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Elaugh, humans have their limits.</color>
units.displayText: Elaugh, humans have their limits.

spans.text: Elaugh, humans have their limits.

units.rawText: <color=orange>But as a program rooted in 1s and 0s, the god of the cloud server has no limits.</color>
units.displayText: But as a program rooted in 1s and 0s, the god of the cloud server has no limits.

spans.text: But as a program rooted in 1s and 0s, the god of the cloud server has no limits.

units.rawText: Elaugh is so shocked by the sight before her that she cannot speak. Meanwhile, Avram continues speaking quietly, practically whispering into her ear.
units.displayText: Elaugh is so shocked by the sight before her that she cannot speak. Meanwhile, Avram continues speaking quietly, practically whispering into her ear.

spans.text: Elaugh is so shocked by the sight before her that she cannot speak. Meanwhile, Avram continues speaking quietly, practically whispering into her ear.

units.rawText: Elaugh, you must be faster, much faster.
units.displayText: Elaugh, you must be faster, much faster.

spans.text: Elaugh, you must be faster, much faster.

units.rawText: When we consider Ascension Sector's ultimate goal, we don't have enough time.
units.displayText: When we consider Ascension Sector's ultimate goal, we don't have enough time.
